रॉकी स्टार Sylvester Stallone की लाइफ का यह इमोशनल सच जानकर आप भी हैरान रह जाएंगे! 🐶💔

Hollywood स्टार Sylvester Stallone जब शुरुआती दिनों में तंगहाली से जूझ रहे थे, तब उन्हें खाने का इंतजाम करने के लिए 7-Eleven के बाहर अपना प्यारा कुत्ता Butkus सिर्फ $40 में बेचना पड़ा था। हालांकि 2013 के एक इंटरव्यू में उन्होंने इसे $50 में बेचना बताया था।

जब उनकी Rocky की script बिकी, तो उन्होंने अपने कुत्ते को वापस लाने की पूरी कोशिश की। लेकिन Butkus को वापस पाने की कीमत पर कई अलग-अलग दावे हैं। 2013 में Stallone ने दावा किया कि उन्होंने $3,000 देकर कुत्ता वापस खरीदा, वहीं बाद में Instagram पर लिखा कि मालिक ने फायदा उठाकर $15,000 वसूले थे।

दूसरी ओर Total Rocky रिपोर्ट का दावा है कि Stallone ने मिन्नतें कीं और परिवार मान गया, जिसमें किसी पेमेंट का जिक्र नहीं है। वहीं फिल्म I Play Rocky के निर्देशक के मुताबिक यह रकम $4,000 थी, जिसे फिल्म के लिए $1,000 कर दिया गया।

ctx.title: The Heartbreaking Reason Sylvester Stallone Had To Sell His Dog Instead Of His Rocky Script
ctx.summary:
Sylvester Stallone was so broke while trying to get Rocky made that he faced an impossible choice: sell his beloved dog or give up the script. 
 The post  The Heartbreaking Reason Sylvester Stallone Had To Sell His Dog Instead Of His Rocky Script  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
When Sylvester Stallone became a Hollywood superstar, he struggled to afford even the basic necessities. In fact, his financial troubles became so serious that he had to sell his beloved dog, Butkus. However, the story took an unexpected turn when Stallone finally sold his Rocky screenplay.
Over the years, the actor shared the emotional story several times. But one detail has changed with every retelling. While he once claimed that he spent $3,000 to get Butkus back, he later increased the amount to a whopping $15,000 .
With the release of I Play Rocky, the personal story of Sylvester Stallone and his dog has regained attention. Although the movie revisits the actor’s struggles before his breakthrough, Butkus’s real story is even more interesting because nobody seems to agree on how much he actually paid to get his dog back.
Before getting fame from Rocky, Sylvester Stallone had Butkus in his life. The dog was there with him during some of his toughest years. According to sources, Stallone’s financial situation became so bad that he could no longer afford to keep the dog. As a result, he sold the dog to a man outside a 7-Eleven for just $40 to afford food.
In a 2013 interview , he claimed he sold Butkus for $50 rather than $40 . In a 2017 Instagram post , Stallone shared a picture of himself with the dog when the dog was a puppy in 1971 . This suggests their bond began much earlier. But even after selling the dog, Stallone never forgot him.
When Sylvester Stallone finally sold his Rocky screenplay, he decided to bring Butkus home. According to Total Rocky , Stallone approached the family and begged them to return the dog. Even though the family was initially hesitant, they eventually agreed after multiple requests from Stallone.
In 2013, Stallone claimed that he bought Butkus back for $3,000. But later, when he shared the story on Instagram, he quoted a much higher figure. This time, he shared that the dog’s owner took advantage of him and demanded a whopping $15,000. But he still bought his dog back.
But Stallone’s version differs from Total Rocky’s, which doesn’t mention any payment. On the other hand, the I Play Rocky director mentioned the figure as $4,000 to bring Butkus home. However, the director reduced the amount to $1,000 because he thought carrying $4,000 in cash would look unrealistic.
As a result, the story now has multiple versions. While Stallone may have paid a significant amount to get Butkus back, there is no clear evidence to support the figure.
